``` {r}
# ============================================
# EUROPEAN BLACK-SCHOLES
# ============================================

# European Call Option
bs_european_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1) - K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(d2)
  return(price)
}

# European Put Option  
bs_european_put <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1)
  return(price)
}
```

``` {r s_star}
# Calculate critical commodity price

s-star-finder <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  b <- r - q
  N <- 2*b/(sigma^2)
  M <- 2*r/(sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_2 <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other))/2

  RHS <- function(S_i) {
    d_one <- (log(S_i/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    return(bs_european_call(S_i, K, r, sigma, T, q) + (1 - (exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(d_one))) * S_i / q_2)
  }

  b_i <- function(S_i) { # Slope of RHS
    d_one <- (log(S_i/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    val <- exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(d_one) * (1 - 1/q_2) + (1 - (exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(d_one))/(sigma * sqrt(T))) / q_2
    return(val)
  }

  enhance_guess <- function(S_i) {
    cur_bi <- b_i(S_i)
    return((K - RHS(S_i) - cur_bi * S_i)/(1 - cur_bi))
  }
  # Get initial guess
  S_inf <- K / (1 - 2 / (- (N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4*M)))
  h_2 <- -(b*T + 2*sigma*sqrt(T))*(K / (S_inf - K))
  S_i <- K + (S_inf - K) * (1 - exp(h_2))

  # Whilst LHS and RHS are not equal...
  while(abs(S_i - K - RHS(S_i)) / K >= 0.0000001) {
    # ...enhance guess
    S_i <- enhance_guess(S_i)
  }

  return(S_i)
}
```

``` {r s-star-check}
check-s-star <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
if(q <= 0) {
return(TRUE)
}
  S_star <- s-star-finder(S, K, r, sigma, T, q)

  b <- r - q
  d_one <- (log(S_star/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))

  N <- 2*b/(sigma^2)
  M <- 2*r/(sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_2 <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other))/2

  LHS <- S_star - K
  RHS <- bs_european_call(S_star, K, r, sigma, T, q) + (1 - exp((b - r) * T) * pnorm(d_one)) * S_star / q_2

  return(abs(LHS - RHS) < 0.0000001)
}
```
